datasets: Corpora from 15 published systematic reviews in biomedical domain
outputs: Systematic review reports (summaries) with citations and provenance trees

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated dataset descriptions to more accurate representation from paper. Simplified outputs description while maintaining accuracy.
Removed retrieval metrics (precision, recall, F1) used for article screening, not NLG evaluation. Paper explicitly states rubric-based human evaluation, not automatic NLG metrics.
No LLMs used as judges for NLG evaluation - LLMs are used as generation models only.

guideline: Rubric-based evaluation by domain experts scoring on multiple dimensions totaling 100 points
Systematic reviews independently scored by two experts familiar with the topic
Questionnaire covering usability and trustworthiness aspects

changes_made.explanation: Added missing criteria mentioned in paper. Combined coverage & representativeness for clarity. Normalized criterion names.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on systematic review generation using multi-agent LLM systems with human-in-the-loop interaction. The primary NLG task is text summarization/literature review generation. While precision/recall/F1 are mentioned, they're used for article retrieval/screening evaluation, not NLG output evaluation. The paper emphasizes human evaluation with expert raters using detailed rubrics.
